title: Paul Gordan and Clebsch-Gordan: Source-Witnessed LaTeX and Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Paul Gordan / Clebsch-Gordan record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record contains source-witnessed German/Latin transcription and English translation working packets split out from the older mixed additional-author shelf.

Status at a glance. These are package-audited working drafts, not final critical editions. OCR is used only as a non-authoritative prose/block comparator; source renders and included scan witnesses remain the authority for formulas and mathematical readings.

Latest update. Adds Gordan_Abel23_p300_308_DE_EN_20260612.zip, covering Clebsch-Gordan Theorie der Abelschen Functionen source pp.300-308 / printed pp.278-286. The tranche continues and closes §79 and covers all visible content of §80 through the final formula for the integral sums v_h on printed p286. It includes current German/English TeX/PDF, cumulative Abelsche German/English TeX/PDF through source p308, current and cumulative source-scan witnesses, render checks, provenance, OCR comparator material, and audit ledgers. The audit reports no unresolved scan-quality blocker for pp.300-308, applies a prior-layout correction on the p295 phi quotient in the cumulative branch, and preserves a source-visible but mathematically suspicious p306 du_p reading in the final summand. The next continuation point is after source p308 / printed p286.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Adds Abel23 p300-p308, extending the cumulative Abelsche stream through source p308 / printed p286. Abel23 continues and closes section 79 and covers all visible content of section 80 through the final formula for the integral sums v_h. Package-audited working drafts only; OCR scaffold remains noncanonical; source-visible p306 du_p anomaly retained and logged.
